rules: Accept only the exact HTTPS origin and repository path in a verified signed release Manifest.
Require the filename to match the signed browser version, platform, architecture and archive format.
Reject credentials, custom ports, query strings, fragments, encoded path separators and redirects.
Never send session or download-ticket credentials to the public CDN origin.
Retain signed size, SHA-256 and Browser/Driver pairing checks before installation.
License authorization, concurrency and revocation remain server and kernel responsibilities.
